name: MAKE GROUND
title: Grow the Field
current_claim: When independent evidence paths remain in meaningful disagreement, change the substrate only enough to make better evidence easier to produce, preserve, compare, and repeat.
source_ancestry: Lay the Bones, Wake the Soil
MAKE GROUND — A Field Manual for Growing Possible Futures

doors.signal: MAKE THE FIELD MORE CAPABLE OF MAKING ITS OWN NEXT LAYER.
doors.story: A disagreement becomes more resolvable when the environment makes repeatable observation cheaper than argument.
doors.theory: Evidence fertility is a substrate property: the field makes future observation, comparison, correction, and repetition easier without deciding the result in advance.
doors.field: One reversible substrate change plus one declared observation channel.
doors.return: A measured fertility delta and a new source artifact that can re-enter WITNESS.

crossings.law: UNRESOLVED DISAGREEMENT ≠ LICENSE FOR TOTAL REDESIGN.
